luiskr.com / core/utils/wasm/wasm-layout / calcMediaScale

function calcMediaScale(naturalW, naturalH, boundW, boundH): number

Defined in: core/utils/wasm/wasm-layout.ts:300

Contain-fit scale for media inside a bounding box, clamped to 1: min(boundW/naturalW, boundH/naturalH, 1) — the media may shrink to fit both bounds but is never upscaled past its natural pixel size. This is the hard guarantee behind the natural-dimension cap: multiplying the natural dims by the returned scale yields a box that can never exceed the source file's real pixels, so object-fit: cover inside that box renders at ≤100% of the source and physically cannot upscale it. Non-positive inputs yield 0 (callers treat it as "no constraint").

Parameters

naturalW

number

Source file width in px.

naturalH

number

Source file height in px.

boundW

number

Layout width bound in px.

boundH

number

Layout height bound in px.

Returns

number

Scale factor in [0, 1].
